title: taiwan-foresttype-s1s2: broadleaf, conifer and bamboo forest-type classification across Taiwan from Sentinel-1/2, climate and terrain (code, data and trained model)
description: Open dataset, trained Random Forest and reproducible pipeline for the manuscript 'Classification of Broadleaf, Conifer and Bamboo Forests Across Taiwan by Multi-Source Remote Sensing and Interpretable Machine Learning' (IEEE JSTARS, JSTARS-2026-04232, revised version). 755 inventory-based reference points with 34 features from Sentinel-2 optical phenology, Sentinel-1 SAR, ERA5-Land climate and SRTM terrain for the 2021-2024 training window and the 2025-06 to 2026-05 independent year, the spatial-block fold definition (0.1 x 0.09 degree graticule cells), the scripts that reproduce Table 1 and the revision analyses, the Google Earth Engine feature exporter, and the trained model.

creators.name: Hsu, Yu-Chun
creators.affiliation: Department of Forestry, National Chung Hsing University, Taichung, Taiwan
